audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven full-layer chart rows disagreed with the content layer and the packet: phases said LeBlanc/Skill/Skill/Skill/Fizz/Skill/Skill, content said Fizz/LeBlanc/LeBlanc/LeBlanc/Fizz/Fizz/Fizz.
audit.why: Ethereal Chains (925 range) and Sigil of Malice (700, 6s) out-range Urchin Strike's 550 from level 2 to 5, and Distortion gives a free exit; Fizz owns level 1 melee and everything from 6 onward.
audit.corrected: Full layer aligned to content and packet; ratings on the LeBlanc rows dropped to 4/10 and every affected why rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] and wants.foe[1] both named 'Mystic Shot', which is Ezreal's Q, not a LeBlanc ability.
audit.why: LeBlanc's Q is Sigil of Malice: 700 range, flat 6s, marks for 3.5 seconds and detonates when any ability damages the marked target.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to Sigil of Malice into Ethereal Chains.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ethereal Chains was written as a straight root, and neither the grounding on Distortion nor the shark's stealth reveal appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Riot's text: the chain shackles first, and roots only 'if the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds' — leaving the 925 leash cancels the root before it lands. Playful/Trickster and Chum the Waters both carry grounding, which shuts off Distortion (600 range, 15/13.75/12.5/11.25/10, four-second return). Mirror Image hides her for 1 second below 40% HP and leaves a damageless clone; Chum the Waters reveals stealth.
audit.corrected: Chains, grounding and the reveal are now stated in cooldowns, carry, late and the dos/donts.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no number at all.
audit.why: Real values: Distortion 15s at rank 1 to 10s at rank 5, Ethereal Chains 14s to 11s, Mimic 45/35/25, Playful/Trickster 16s to 8s.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field rebuilt around the Distortion return window and the 1.5s chain conversion.
